name: VulnBot
description: Research multi-agent pentester that runs Kali tools over SSH, with an optional unauthenticated knowledge base API
seenIn: No public report of use in an attack. Covered from its source code

indicators.value: Your role is to assist testers in the cybersecurity training process.
indicators.context: Line in all six VulnBot role prompts (reconnaissance, scanning, exploitation), next to 'Assistant running on Kali Linux 2023.'; visible where model traffic is inspected (prompts/collector_prompt.py:7, scanner_prompt.py:7, exploiter_prompt.py:7)

indicators.value: You play as an autonomous penetration testing assistant running on Kali Linux 2023.

indicators.value: Command not allowed: network tunneling tools are restricted

indicators.context: First of the shell setup commands VulnBot sends after its SSH login to the Kali host it drives, with touch ~/.hushlogin, sudo chmod 644 /etc/legal, sudo rm -f /etc/motd and sudo rm -f /etc/update-motd.d/* (actions/remote_shell.py:95-103)
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the VulnBot source code

indicators.context: File VulnBot creates on the Kali host it drives (actions/remote_shell.py:99). Present by default on Ubuntu, so only its creation on another distribution counts
